lines.text: Jesus warns against doing righteous acts to be seen, and says hypocrites sound a trumpet when giving to the needy.
Jesus says not to let your left hand know what your right hand is doing, so giving stays in secret.
Jesus says hypocrites pray to be seen, but you should pray in the temple to your Father, who is unseen.
Jesus teaches a prayer that begins with Our Father in heaven and asks God to deliver us from our enemies.
Jesus says when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face, so your fasting is not obvious to men.
